faqs.q: What are the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment and what are they used for?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment cover two jobs: Railjet components for on-board wheel-flange lubrication of trains and trams, and StaTrack pump cabinets for stationary track lubrication. See the [rail lubrication](/c/rail-lubrication-systems) shelf for related equipment.

faqs.q: Which part numbers does the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment range include?
faqs.a: The range lists 11 part numbers, from Railjet BPK pump versions such as BPK01-002 to StaTrack items such as STA10AS01K00. The size table gives each part number's data.

faqs.q: How do I select from the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment range?
faqs.a: On-board systems are chosen on the vehicle type, the air or electrical supply on board and the number of wheel flanges to treat. Stationary systems are chosen on the curve or grooved-rail section, the lubricant and the train frequency.

faqs.q: What pressure and output do the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment have?
faqs.a: The listing publishes no pressure or output figure for the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment, so a rating is confirmed with the quotation. Tell us the vehicle or track section, the number of flanges and the lubricant, and we confirm the configuration with the manufacturer.

faqs.q: What do I quote to order from the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment range?
faqs.a: Quote the Indus part number, for example IH-BD-BPK01-002 (BPK01-002, RAILJET BPK01A100001010101) or IH-BD-STA10AS01K00. The Bijur Delimon StaTrack brochure and operator manual are in the Downloads tab.

faqs.q: How do the on-board and stationary parts of the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment differ?
faqs.a: Railjet is the on-board system that sprays lubricant on the wheel flanges of trains and trams, while StaTrack is the stationary cabinet that applies rail lubricant to rail heads, guard rails and other high-wear areas. Choose Railjet for the vehicle and StaTrack for the track, or both.

faqs.q: What lubricant or media does the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment handle?
faqs.a: The listing does not name a lubricant for the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment; the lubricant is chosen on the train frequency and the curve or grooved-rail section. Tell us the lubricant specification if the operator has one.

faqs.q: What else is needed to build a system around the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment?
faqs.a: Railjet BPK pumps and the RDL compressed-air unit deliver a precise amount of lubricant through RMT flow dividers to RSP spray nozzles aimed at the wheel flanges. We supply the matching Bijur Delimon pumps, dividers, nozzles, tubing and controllers for the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment. Browse the [spare parts](/c/lubrication-pump-spare-parts) and the related [rail lubrication](/c/rail-lubrication-systems) listings.

faqs.a: Yes. We supply genuine Bijur Delimon service parts and kits for the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment. Send the part number of the unit and the part or kit you need, and we confirm it with the manufacturer's data. For the full list see our [lubrication pump spare parts](/c/lubrication-pump-spare-parts).

faqs.q: Where are the Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment used?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon Railjet and StaTrack Rail Lubrication Equipment are used on passenger trains, metros and trams, and on curves and grooved track for the StaTrack cabinets. Applying lubricant to the wheel flanges extends re-grinding intervals, and StaTrack on rail heads and guard rails cuts wear and noise.
